title: Sotto wants rules on senators' prolonged, unauthorized absences
summary: Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente Sotto III filed Senate Resolution 751 seeking to institutionalize guidelines on how to address the prolonged and unauthorized absence of members of the chamber.
